en: A color postcard showing a panoramic view of the city of Graz with a prominent green hill (the Schlossberg) rising above the historic center. Buildings with red-tiled roofs surround the hill, and a river with embankments and bridges runs through the city to the right. In the background are distant mountains and a broad valley. Printed text at the top left reads "Graz, vom Rainerkogel," and there is cursive handwriting across the upper right.
